hub.title: AAC Engineering Center
hub.subtitle: Complete Engineering, Machinery & Plant Design Intelligence for Autoclaved Aerated Concrete Manufacturing
hub.hero_statement: Engineering high-efficiency AAC manufacturing facilities through precise raw material preparation, optimal plant layout, synchronized cycle automation, and robust autoclave curing systems.

pillars.title: AAC Block Production Process
pillars.summary: From raw material slurry preparation and high-speed hydrodynamic mixing to hydrogen aerating, green-cake wire cutting, and 12-hour hydrothermal synthesis inside autoclaves.

pillars.title: AAC Plant Layout Design
pillars.summary: Master planning factory layouts for optimal material logistics, single vs double-door autoclave through-feed lines, crane vs ferry cart circulation, and phase-2 expansion without line shutdown.

pillars.title: Complete AAC Plant & Capacity Selection
pillars.tagline: Batch Sizing, Autoclave Balancing & TPH Matching
pillars.summary: Why real plant output depends on total system synchronization—matching mixer batch volume (4.0–6.0 m³), cutting cycle time (3.5–4.5 min), autoclave schedule (10–12h), and boiler TPH.

pillars.title: Plant Machinery & Equipment
pillars.summary: Engineered and manufactured in-house by Laxmi En-Fab: Silo systems, Ball mills, Batching towers, Pre-curing lines, 90° Tilting cranes, High-precision wire cutters, Autoclaves, Steam Boilers & Auto Palletizers.

machinery_modules.title: Raw Material Storage & Pneumatic Conveying
machinery_modules.short_desc: Engineered silos (60T to 200T) for fly ash, cement, and lime with fluidization pads, dust collectors, pneumatic conveying, and sand/pond ash covered stockyards.

machinery_modules.title: Batching System & Raw Material Preparation
machinery_modules.short_desc: Continuous wet-grinding ball mills, high-shear slurry agitators, ultrasonic density control, high-precision load-cell dosing, and automated aluminum powder dispensing.

machinery_modules.title: Mould Handling & Pre-Curing System
machinery_modules.short_desc: CNC-machined rigid moulds, detachable bottom side plates, heavy-duty hydraulic ferry carts, and insulated pre-curing tunnels maintaining 40–50°C for cake rising.

machinery_modules.title: AAC 90° Tilting Machine & Demoulding
machinery_modules.short_desc: Hydraulic zero-shock 90° tilting crane fixture that secures the side plate, smoothly turns the cake upright, and unlocks the mould box without cake cracking or edge damage.

machinery_modules.title: High-Precision AAC Cutting System
machinery_modules.short_desc: High-frequency oscillating horizontal cutting wires, rigid vertical cross-cut frame, top/bottom crust skimming, tongue-and-groove profiling, and automatic wet-slurry recycling.

machinery_modules.title: High-Pressure Autoclave Curing Vessels
machinery_modules.short_desc: ASME / Indian Boiler Regulations (IBR) certified curing cylinders (Ø2.0m–Ø2.5m, 21m–35m length) operating at 12–14 bar (190°C) with quick-opening safety interlock doors.

machinery_modules.title: Industrial Steam Boiler & Energy Recovery
machinery_modules.short_desc: Biomass / Coal / Gas / Dual-fuel steam boilers (4 TPH to 12 TPH) engineered to deliver high-pressure saturated steam with economizers and automated condensate recovery systems.

machinery_modules.title: Automatic Palletizing & Packaging Line
machinery_modules.short_desc: Hydraulic cake clamps, de-sticking separating tables, high-speed block stackers, wooden pallet dispensers, and automated stretch-wrapping/PET strapping lines.

process_stages.title: Raw Material Preparation & Grinding
process_stages.desc: Fly ash or silica sand is wet-milled in a continuous ball mill to a fineness of 45-micron residue <15%, producing slurry at 1.60–1.70 kg/L specific gravity.

process_stages.title: Dosing & High-Speed Hydrodynamic Mixing
process_stages.desc: Automated batching scales measure cement, quicklime, gypsum, and slurry with ±0.5% precision. Aluminum paste suspension is dosed into the high-shear mixer.

process_stages.title: Pouring & Hydrogen Aeration Expansion
process_stages.desc: Slurry is poured into pre-oiled mould boxes. Chemical reaction generates millions of microscopic hydrogen bubbles, causing the cake to expand to 2x volume.

process_stages.title: Static Pre-Curing & Cake Hardening
process_stages.desc: Moulds circulate through temperature-controlled pre-curing tunnels (40–50°C) for 120–180 minutes until green cake achieves wire-cutting penetration resistance.

process_stages.title: 90° Mould Tilting & Demoulding
process_stages.desc: The hydraulic tilting crane turns the mould 90° upright onto a side plate. The mould outer body lifts off, leaving the green cake standing vertically.

process_stages.title: High-Precision 2-Axis Wire Cutting
process_stages.desc: High-speed oscillating steel wires execute horizontal slicing followed by vertical cross-cutting to exact block/panel dimensions (±1mm tolerance).

process_stages.title: Autoclave Hydrothermal Synthesis
process_stages.desc: Curing at 12–14 bar saturated steam pressure and 190°C for 10–12 hours. SiO2 and Ca(OH)2 synthesize into Tobermorite crystals for permanent strength.

process_stages.title: De-Panning, Separation & Auto Palletizing
process_stages.desc: Autoclaved cakes are transported to the de-stacking line. Hydraulic clamps separate sintered contact layers and pack blocks onto strapped wooden pallets.

process_stages.title: Quality Assurance & Yard Dispatch
process_stages.desc: Tested for compressive strength (3.5–5.0 N/mm²), dry density (550–650 kg/m³), thermal conductivity (0.12–0.16 W/mK), and dimensional accuracy per IS 2185-3.
